# Restored PaddleClas documentation images

Original unmodified images from PaddlePaddle/PaddleClas, release/2.3 commit
`4e6d13e35f6c8f327b4670c1c0766bd6afade7fa`, `docs/images/image_aug/`.
The Wiki image-augmentation notes already use the same filenames, captions,
examples and method descriptions as upstream `docs/zh_CN/algorithm_introduction/DataAugmentation.md`.
These files restore missing illustrations without rewriting either article.

manifest.json records immutable source URLs and SHA-256 hashes.

The build copies these images to both historical URL prefixes:
- `/Wiki/images/image_aug/`
- `/Wiki/20-数据科学/images/image_aug/`

No image is regenerated or substituted.
